## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

136: export function buildSpec(car, upgrades = {}) {
137:   const u = {
138:     engine: upgrades.engine | 0,
139:     tires: upgrades.tires | 0,
140:     weight: upgrades.weight | 0,
141:     gearbox: upgrades.gearbox | 0,
142:   };
143:   return {
144:     id: car.id,
145:     name: car.name,
146:     mass: car.mass * (1 - 0.03 * u.weight),
147:     torque: car.torque * (1 + 0.07 * u.engine),
148:     peakRpm: car.peakRpm,
149:     redline: car.redline,
150:     idle: car.idle,
151:     gears: car.gears.slice(),
152:     finalDrive: car.finalDrive * (1 + 0.02 * u.gearbox),
153:     wheelRadius: car.wheelRadius,
154:     cdA: car.cdA,
155:     grip: car.grip * (1 + 0.05 * u.tires),
156:     launchRpm: car.launchRpm,
157:   };
158: }

160: // Pequeno "dyno" pra exibir potência estimada no menu.
161: export function estimatePower(car, upgrades) {
162:   const s = buildSpec(car, upgrades);
163:   const rpm = s.peakRpm;
164:   const w = (rpm * Math.PI * 2) / 60;
165:   return Math.round((s.torque * w) / 745.7);

We need to figure out remaining issues. There are obvious bugs:

1. carModel `paintMaterial` makes new material per car; setPaint updates per model. Fine.
2. Brake light loop checks emissive.r > 0.5 and emissive.g < 0.2 - taillight material is shared mats.taillight across all cars, so player traversal toggles shared material (comment acknowledges). Fine.
3. In updateRace, when foul, greenReached eventually true via updateTree->onGreen. Then race still proceeds; finishRace sets win false. Fine.
4. Major bug: `positionForShowroom` calls `this.effects.clear()` before `effects` created? initTrack creates effects before openMenu. Fine.
5. `nextRival` uses careerWins. If careerWins >= RIVALS length, idx capped to last, extraCycles grows. Good.
6. `startRace` sets `this.playerModel.setPaint(...)` using paint id. Fine.
7. Physics: in `step`, during locked with throttle and clutch, engine rpm ramps to redline. launchRpm ~3900. When releasing, releaseRpm etc. Starting with clutch true and throttle, okay.
8. But after green, if player doesn't release clutch, engine still free; they must release. Fine.
9. Tach maybe huge.
10. UI scoreboard etc.

Need to run and inspect. Need npm install. Also test with playwright. Let's install first.

Below you will find a complete list of every known and reported Minecraft RTX issue, as well as their current status on Mojang's issue reporting site, [Mojira](https://bugs.mojang.com/).

The issues are listed based on priority, if an issue you've encountered is missing from this list, and you believe it is related to the game, report it through Mojira, but if you think it is related to Vanilla RTX, or Vanilla RTX App, report it to Cubeir 

If a reported or known Minecraft RTX issue is missing from this list in particular, a bug is miscategorized, has the wrong link, etc... please [open an issue](https://github.com/vanilla-rtx/Minecraft-RTX-Bug-Tracking/issues) or [a pull request](https://github.com/vanilla-rtx/Minecraft-RTX-Bug-Tracking/pulls).

## Table of Contents

- [🟥 Unresolved Issues](#-unresolved)
- [🟧 Issues Mojang Won't Fix](#-mojang-wont-fix)
- [🟨 Issues worked around by Supervanilla RTX, Vanilla RTX or other means](#-worked-around)
  - [Fixed by Supervanilla RTX](#fixed-by-supervanilla-rtx)
  - [Fixed by Vanilla RTX](#fixed-by-vanilla-rtx)
  - [Worked around by the Vanilla RTX App](#worked-around-by-the-vanilla-rtx-app)
- [🟩 Resolved Issues](#-resolved)
- [⚒️ Vanilla RTX Bug Tracking](#vanilla-rtx-bug-tracking)

## 🟥 Unresolved

These issues have been reported on Mojira, regardless of confirmation status, they remain unresolved. (Sorted based on severity, from highest to lowest).  
You will need to login or create an account to be able to vote.

- [MCPE-183773](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MCPE/issues/MCPE-183773) - Entity UV Animations do not work once RTX is enabled.
- [MCPE-241723](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MCPE/issues/MCPE-241723) - Animated flipbook textures no longer animate smoothly with ray tracing enabled

- [MCPE-119895](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MCPE/issues/MCPE-119895) - Glass loses transparency at a distance with Ray Tracing on
- [MCPE-119941](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MCPE/issues/MCPE-119941) - Transparent parts of an entity's texture stop particles from rendering behind them
- [MCPE-111406](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MCPE/issues/MCPE-111406) - Chests are culled when off screen with Ray Tracing on

index 2d1cee4..bb64679 100755
--- a/capture.sh
+++ b/capture.sh
@@ -1,4 +1,74 @@
 #!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Capture desktop and mobile evidence of the running preview.
+# Opens its own browser, writes final-desktop.png and final-mobile.png into
+# CAPTURE_DIR, closes the browser and leaves the app running.
+# Exit 75 = temporary navigation/browser infrastructure failure.
+# Exit 1  = script or rendering defect.
 set -euo pipefail
-cd "$(dirname "$0")"
-/usr/bin/time -p node "${RUNTIME_DIR:?}/scripts/default-capture.mjs"
+
+timed() { /usr/bin/time -p "$@"; }
+
+PROJECT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
+cd "$PROJECT_DIR"
+
+if [[ -z "${CAPTURE_URL:-}" || -z "${CAPTURE_DIR:-}" ]]; then
+  echo "capture.sh requires CAPTURE_URL and CAPTURE_DIR." >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+if [[ ! "$CAPTURE_URL" =~ ^https?:// ]]; then
+  echo "CAPTURE_URL must be an http(s) URL (got '$CAPTURE_URL')." >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+if [[ -z "${RUNTIME_DIR:-}" || ! -f "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/default-capture.mjs" ]]; then
+  echo "RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/default-capture.mjs is missing; cannot drive Playwright." >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+# Evidence must stay outside the source tree.
+project_real="$(realpath -m "$PROJECT_DIR")"
+capture_real="$(realpath -m "$CAPTURE_DIR")"
+case "$capture_real/" in
+  "$project_real"/*)
+    echo "CAPTURE_DIR must be outside the project (got '$CAPTURE_DIR')." >&2
+    exit 1
+    ;;
+esac
+
+echo "==> Capturing $CAPTURE_URL into $CAPTURE_DIR"
+timed mkdir -p "$CAPTURE_DIR"
+
+# Keep only freshly captured evidence.
+for name in final-desktop.png final-mobile.png; do
+  if [[ -f "$CAPTURE_DIR/$name" ]]; then
+    timed rm -f "$CAPTURE_DIR/$name"
+  fi
+done
+
+# Wait for the game canvas instead of merely <body>, so a blank bootstrap page
+# is never accepted as rendered content.
+CAPTURE_READY_SELECTOR="${CAPTURE_READY_SELECTOR:-canvas}"
+export CAPTURE_READY_SELECTOR
+
+/usr/bin/time -p node "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/default-capture.mjs"
+
+# Validate the evidence the controller will publish.
+for name in final-desktop.png final-mobile.png; do
+  file="$CAPTURE_DIR/$name"
+  if [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then
+    echo "Capture did not produce $name." >&2
+    exit 1
+  fi
+  signature="$(head -c 8 "$file" | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')"
+  if [[ "$signature" != "89504e470d0a1a0a" ]]; then
+    echo "$name is not a PNG image." >&2
+    exit 1
+  fi
+  size="$(stat -c %s "$file")"
+  if (( size <= 24 )); then
+    echo "$name is empty ($size bytes)." >&2
+    exit 1
+  fi
+  echo "==> $name: $size bytes"
+done
+
+echo "==> Capture complete"
